programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: Extreme Influence - S2E4. In a gripping new Court TV original documentary series, host David Scott (HBO Real Sports, ABC News) ventures inside high-security prisons to delve into the minds of convicted murderers. Through in-depth interviews and direct confrontations, Scott seeks to uncover the motives and mindsets that led these individuals to commit murder. The series offers a rare glimpse into the psychological and emotional factors driving heinous crimes, providing viewers with a chilling yet insightful look at some of the most dangerous criminals behind bars. (04/27/2025)

The celebrities switch teams in round two, and in round three the trailing team picks the comedian partner they believe will help them win.
